name: The Medicine Network
description: Iron Mother has been building a network of medical caches across East Africa for emergency use. Three cache points need to be established and stocked before the next raider season. Physical on-site work required.

stages.name: Establish Cache Point Alpha — Mombasa Coast
stages.description: Travel to the old Mombasa coast and establish the first medical cache point. Iron Mother's supply crate will need to be secured in a location accessible to the nearby settlement.

stages.name: Establish Cache Point Beta — Dar es Salaam Ruins
stages.description: Head south along the coast to the Dar es Salaam ruins. The second cache must be hidden but findable by anyone using Iron Mother's distribution codes.

stages.name: Establish Cache Point Gamma — Kilimanjaro Foothills
stages.description: The third cache is inland, in the foothills of old Kilimanjaro. The altitude makes it secure from flooding and raiders who don't know the mountain routes.
